text: 中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理何立峰28日在深圳出席2026年亚太经合组织林业部长级会议开幕式并致辞。 何立峰强调，亚太是全球森林资源最富集、生态系统类型最多样的地区之一，森林面积占全球一半以上。中国始终致力于维护全球生态安全，传播生态文化和绿色理念，为亚太地区乃至全球生态文明建设贡献了中国智慧、中国方案。在各方共同努力下，亚太地区成为扭转全球森林资源下降趋势的主要力量。（新华社）
text_en: He Lifeng, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, attended and addressed the opening ceremony of the 2026 APEC Ministerial Meeting on Forestry in Shenzhen on the 28th. He Lifeng emphasized that the Asia-Pacific is one of the regions with the richest forest resources and most diverse ecosystem types, accounting for over half of the world's forests. China is committed to maintaining global ecological security, spreading ecological culture and green concepts, and contributing Chinese wisdom and solutions to ecological civilization in the Asia-Pacific and globally. Through joint efforts, the Asia-Pacific has become a major force reversing the global decline in forest resources. (Xinhua)
